question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.value} runs well ahead of net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income.value}, a ratio of {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income.value}, and accruals over average assets are negative at {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets.value}. That is the healthy direction. The quarter itself is a different picture: quarterly operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter.value} sits below quarterly net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter.value}, and both income and cash were lifted by a one-time tariff recovery that management itself says is inside net income, adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDA. The six-month cash flow statement shows a receivables build, a large use of cash in other assets (contract assets and a tariff refund receivable) and a large drawdown of other accrued liabilities (the legal settlement payment), offset by a payables build and a deferred-tax swing to expense. Trailing operating cash flow fell {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters.value} against the year-earlier trailing window while the quarter's net income rose {ratios.growth.net_income.year_over_year.value}, so the quarter's earnings jump has not yet shown up as trailing cash. Income is smoother than cash ({earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.value}), which for an outage-driven generator maker is expected rather than alarming.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: earnings quality is acceptable on a trailing basis but the current quarter overstates the recurring run-rate because of the tariff refund; cash conversion in the quarter lagged income

revenue_recognition.finding: Revenue is mostly point-in-time on shipment to dealers and distributors, but the data center ramp is introducing over-time, cost-to-cost recognition. The contract balances note was rewritten this quarter: a contract-asset disclosure appears for the first time and the unbilled balance rose sharply from a small base at year-end, meaning a growing slice of C&I revenue is recognized on costs incurred before it is billed. Contract liabilities (customer deposits) fell from year-end as deposits were consumed into revenue, although at {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities.value} they remain far above the year-ago {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities.value}. Remaining performance obligations disclosed in the notes fell from the prior quarter even as the press release describes a rapidly rising data center backlog; the note applies the practical expedient that excludes contracts of one year or less, so the two figures are not the same population, but the direction of the two measures diverges. Receivables rose over the six months ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.value} over the trailing window), yet days sales outstanding at {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding.value} and the quarter's receivables-to-revenue are near the low end of the recent range, and floor-plan financing keeps roughly an eighth of sales off the receivables ledger.
revenue_recognition.verdict: no evidence of premature recognition, but the shift toward cost-to-cost accounting and the backlog-versus-RPO gap make revenue timing more judgment-dependent than a year ago

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Four estimates carry weight this quarter. First, the tariff recovery is booked under a loss-recovery model and includes a receivable management has deemed probable; the split between the amount taken to cost of goods sold and the remainder parked in inventory is itself a judgment. Second, the standard warranty provision issued in the quarter was lower than a year ago even though net sales grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year.value}, and the warranty accrual of {terms.balances_now.warranty_accrual.value} against quarterly revenue sits at the second-lowest reading of the last six quarters; changes in estimates for pre-existing warranties keep adding to the reserve, which says prior accruals were light. Third, the Enercon earnout is carried at fair value, is tied to target EBITDA levels, is partly payable in restricted shares, and now dominates a contingent-consideration liability that is mostly current; contingent-consideration adjustments are excluded from adjusted EBITDA, so later true-ups will not touch the headline metric. Fourth, the segment reorganization reshuffled reporting units, goodwill was reallocated on relative fair value, and the interim impairment test produced only a small charge in Residential while acquisitions added goodwill that is the majority of the purchase price. The credit-loss allowance of {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance.value} is the lowest of the last six quarters relative to receivables.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: reserves are within normal bounds but several are drifting in the income-friendly direction at the same time: warranty accrual rate down, allowance rate down, goodwill largely unimpaired after a re-basing, and a tariff receivable recognized on a probability judgment

cost_deferral.finding: Two forms of deferral matter. The part of the tariff recovery not taken through cost of goods sold was recorded in inventories, which lowers the carrying cost of goods still on hand and will flow through as lower cost of sales in later quarters; that is a deferred margin benefit, not a recurring cost improvement. Acquisition accounting capitalized intangibles and goodwill, and amortization of intangibles rose year over year; the company then adds that amortization back in adjusted net income, so the adjusted per-share figure is on a basis that never charges for the acquired assets. Research and development remains fully expensed ({terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.value} trailing). Inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory.value} is slightly below a year ago, with raw materials down and finished goods up; days of inventory at {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value} remain elevated against the company's own history, and the record carries no inventory reserve tag, so the adequacy of obsolescence reserves cannot be checked from the data.
cost_deferral.verdict: no aggressive capitalization of operating costs; the deferrals to watch are the tariff benefit sitting in inventory and the growing amortization add-back

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Reported operating cash flow benefits from several classification and timing effects. Cash taxes are running below book taxes under the new bonus-depreciation and R&D expensing rules, and the deferred tax line swung to a large expense from a benefit, so part of the operating cash flow is a timing gain. Taxes paid on equity awards, which are a cash cost of compensation, sit in financing and grew several-fold. Acquisition consideration was partly settled in treasury stock and the Enercon earnout is partly in restricted shares, so the investing outflow understates what was paid. The dealer floor-plan arrangement converts dealer receivables to cash on shipment and now carries a larger outstanding balance than at year-end; the company can be required to repurchase inventory if dealers default, which is an unrecorded contingent obligation. On the other side, the six-month operating cash flow absorbed the company's share of a large legal settlement and a working-capital build, so the quarter is not flattered on every line. Free cash flow simple over the trailing window is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple.value}; after share-based compensation and acquisition cash it is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.value}.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: moderate: no receivable sales or supplier-finance programs are disclosed, but stock-settled deals, financing-classified award taxes, floor-plan financing and a cash-tax holiday all make reported cash generation look better than the underlying economics

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Management concluded disclosure controls were effective and reported no change in internal control over financial reporting during the quarter, despite a segment reorganization that changed reporting units, three closed acquisitions and a first-time cost-to-cost revenue disclosure. The interim statements are unaudited. No late-filing notice is on record and the current-report history is routine earnings releases, an executive change and proxy votes. The legal docket is active: a DOJ grand jury subpoena and EPA/CARB emissions inquiry with a fresh EPA information request this quarter, appealed securities and derivative suits, a consumer class action narrowed by the court, and a patent case settled after the appellate court vacated the judgment. Adjusted EBITDA, which management admits involves judgment and discretion, is both the covenant metric and an executive compensation target.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: no control deficiency is reported, but the combination of unaudited interim numbers, a reorganized reporting structure, discretionary non-GAAP definitions tied to pay, and open regulatory inquiries keeps the signal amber rather than green

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: The press release and the quarterly report agree on every headline figure checked: quarterly net sales, net income, operating cash flow, free cash flow, adjusted EBITDA and the segment tables match line for line, and the calculator's quarterly revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter.value} and operating income of {ratios.growth.operating_income.this_quarter.value} tie to both. The tariff amounts are stated consistently across the release, the MD&A and the note. Three narrative gaps remain. The release headline credits operating leverage, while the segment discussion attributes most of the Residential margin expansion and the entire guidance raise to the tariff refund. The release cites a data center backlog far larger than the remaining performance obligations in the note, which also fell from the prior quarter. Full-year guidance calls for Residential growth in the high single digits although first-half Residential sales declined. Separately, the covenant interest coverage disclosed in the MD&A is far above the calculator's EBIT-based coverage of {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage.value}, because the covenant uses adjusted EBITDA and the calculator uses operating income.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: numbers reconcile; narratives diverge on what drove the margin, how large the contracted backlog really is, and how the second half must perform to meet guidance

industry_lens.finding: Generac is a standby and portable power equipment maker whose Residential demand swings with outages, housing and consumer confidence, and whose C&I business is now being reshaped by hyperscale data center backup orders. The industry pattern that matters for accounting is mix: Residential adjusted EBITDA margin is more than double the C&I margin, and C&I is growing at close to thirty percent while Residential shrinks, so consolidated margins face structural dilution even as revenue accelerates. Data center contracts bring over-time recognition, customer deposits, cancellation rights and delivery penalties that the company itself lists as a new risk. Capital intensity is rising: C&I capital expenditure in the quarter was well above the prior year and management says it is investing aggressively in capacity. Inventory days of {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value} and a cash conversion cycle of {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle.value} are long even for a dealer-channel manufacturer, and the dealer floor-plan program is the channel's shock absorber. Tariff exposure cuts both ways: this quarter's refund is the reversal of costs absorbed earlier, and trade policy remains a listed risk.
industry_lens.verdict: the accounting risks are those of a company pivoting from a high-margin consumer franchise to lower-margin, contract-heavy industrial supply: revenue timing, earnouts, capacity capitalization and customer concentration replace outage seasonality as the main judgment areas

anomalies.name: Full-year Residential growth guidance against a first-half decline
anomalies.name_ko: 상반기 감소에도 연간 주거용 부문 성장 가이던스 제시
anomalies.what: Residential sales fell slightly in the first half, yet the outlook calls for high-single-digit Residential growth for the year, which requires a strong outage-driven second half. Consolidated mid-to-high-teens growth likewise depends on the back half.
anomalies.numbers_vs_prose: Calculator trailing revenue growth {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters.value} and three-year compound growth {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound} are both near or below zero; the prose projects mid-to-high teens for the year.

anomalies.name: Covenant interest coverage far above EBIT-based coverage
anomalies.name_ko: 약정상 이자보상배율이 영업이익 기준 배율을 크게 상회
anomalies.what: The MD&A reports covenant interest coverage and total leverage on the credit-agreement adjusted EBITDA basis; the calculator's EBIT-to-interest ratio is a fraction of the covenant figure and net-debt-to-EBITDA is above the covenant leverage. Both are correct on their own definitions, but covenant headroom is measured on the more generous one.
anomalies.numbers_vs_prose: Calculator interest coverage {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage.value}, debt over EBITDA {ratios.solvency.debt_over_ebitda.value}; the MD&A states much higher coverage and lower leverage.

anomalies.name: Growth concentrated in the lower-margin C&I segment
anomalies.name_ko: 성장은 마진이 낮은 상업·산업 부문에 집중
anomalies.what: C&I grew close to thirty percent while Residential declined; C&I adjusted EBITDA margin is less than half the Residential margin. As data center volumes ramp, consolidated margin faces dilution even with operating leverage, and the release's margin optimism rests on a one-time refund.
anomalies.numbers_vs_prose: Calculator trailing operating margin {ratios.profitability.operating_margin.value} versus the three-year average {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average}; segment prose gives the two margins.

anomalies.name: Data center contract terms and hyperscale concentration
anomalies.name_ko: 데이터센터 계약 조건과 하이퍼스케일 고객 집중
anomalies.what: A new risk factor lists cancellation rights, delivery requirements and liability exposure tied to performance obligations with data center customers; two hyperscale supply agreements now anchor next year's growth. Concentration facts show a single customer already accounts for a meaningful share of receivables.
anomalies.numbers_vs_prose: Calculator concentration facts record one customer near a tenth of receivables in recent years; the prose describes supply agreements committing large volumes.

anomalies.name: Elevated inventory days alongside accelerating capacity spending
anomalies.name_ko: 높은 재고일수와 가속되는 설비투자
anomalies.what: Days of inventory are long against the company's own five-year history and the last fiscal year was the highest; finished goods rose while raw materials fell. At the same time C&I capital expenditure jumped and management plans further capacity, so capital tied up in the business is rising ahead of the revenue it is meant to serve.
anomalies.numbers_vs_prose: Calculator days of inventory {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory.value}, cash conversion cycle {ratios.efficiency.cash_conversion_cycle.value}, trailing capital expenditure {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.value}; the release describes aggressive investment in capacity.

summary_ko: 제너락의 이번 분기 이익 급증은 실제 영업 개선과 일회성 관세 환급이 섞여 있다. 대법원 판결로 회수한 관세 대부분이 매출원가 차감으로 반영되어 분기 매출총이익률이 최근 여섯 분기 중 최고를 기록했고, 회사는 이를 조정 EBITDA와 조정 순이익에서 제외하지 않았으며 연간 마진 가이던스 상향도 주로 이 환급 때문이라고 스스로 밝히고 있다. 후행 네 분기 기준으로는 영업현금흐름이 순이익을 크게 웃돌아 이익의 질은 양호하지만, 분기 단위로는 영업현금흐름이 순이익을 밑돌았고 후행 영업현금흐름은 전년 대비 감소했다. 데이터센터 사업 확대로 원가투입기준 수익인식과 계약자산이 새로 등장했고, 보도자료의 대규모 수주잔고와 주석의 감소한 잔여이행의무가 서로 다른 그림을 보여준다. 보증충당 설정률과 대손충당 비율은 낮아지는 방향이며, Enercon 조건부 대가는 EBITDA 목표에 연동되어 있고 조정 EBITDA에서는 제외된다. 자기주식으로 결제한 인수대가, 재무활동으로 분류된 주식보상 세금, 딜러 플로어플랜 금융, 현금세 절감은 보고된 현금창출력을 실제보다 좋아 보이게 한다. 내부통제 변경은 없다고 보고되었으나 세그먼트 개편·세 건의 인수·미감사 재무제표·진행 중인 규제 조사가 겹쳐 있어 신호는 황색이다.
limits: The calculator carries no field for the tariff recovery, contract assets, the legal settlement, deferred taxes, equity-award taxes or stock-settled consideration, so the adjustments above name no calculator path and cannot be applied mechanically; the amounts live only in the quoted filing text.
Inventory valuation reserves and inventory write-downs are not tagged in the record, so obsolescence reserve adequacy cannot be assessed.
The quarter's operating cash flow is derived by differencing six-month and three-month statements; the fourth quarter of the prior year is missing from the trend table.
Segment margins are on management's adjusted EBITDA basis and prior periods were recast for the reorganization, so segment trends before the recast are not comparable.
Interim statements are unaudited; no auditor report exists for this period.
No prior-run predictions exist for this company, so no flags or management explanations are carried forward.
Digits inside calculator paths and paragraph identifiers are structural keys, not figures written by the analyst.
